description: Work out what a barber, stylist, shop or salon pays Booksy, theCut, Mindbody each month, and set it beside ShearQuery's price for their account type. Use it when someone asks what they would save, mentions fees or commission on their booking app, or asks how ShearQuery's price compares. Ask first, in conversation: which app, what their bill says each month, how many new clients a month the app charges them for, and what a first visit costs. Never guess a number they did not give; the result lists what is still needed. The other app's figures come from its own pricing page and the result names the page and the day it was read. Report the result as given, including when ShearQuery would cost more.

account_type.description: What they are, for ShearQuery's price. A booth or suite renter is barber or cosmetologist; an owner is barbershop or salon. Defaults to barber.

app.description: The booking app they use now.

extra_staff.description: Booksy only: staff members beyond the first, when no bill figure was given.

first_visit_price.description: What a new client's first visit costs, in dollars.

monthly_fee.description: What their bill from the app says each month, in dollars, if they gave it. Leave out to use the app's published price.

new_clients_per_month.description: New clients a month the app charges them a fee for (Booksy Boost, theCut search on the free plan, the Mindbody app).

thecut_plan.description: theCut only: their plan. Defaults to pro.

name: compare_booking_app_cost
title: What a booking app costs them, against ShearQuery
